description: D21b — auto-resolve a paint template for a loaded model. paint_template(auto=true) reads PlacedModel.source (or originalSource for extracted multi-object 3MFs) and looks up the recipe in this index by, in order: (1) MakerWorld design id parsed from the 3MF metadata, (2) sha256 of the source file, (3) filename alias (lowercased basename without extension; for unbranded STLs / common naming conventions). Add new entries via a PR — keep the index small and curated; recipes themselves live alongside as `<name>.json`.
